SuperFOIL Insulation

We fit SuperFOIL insulation systems, including SF19 and SF40, to cut heat loss through roofs and loft spaces. Most installs take 1 to 3 working days.

Fitted to the Manufacturer's Specification

We look at the whole roof structure first so the right product goes in, then install it to the manufacturer's specification, with the right air gaps, ventilation, joints and overlaps. As roofers and insulation specialists, we know how SuperFOIL has to work with the roof that's already there.

What Others Get Wrong

A lot of the SuperFOIL we inspect was fitted by people who don't seem to know the product or haven't had the manufacturer's training. It only performs as specified when the joints are sealed and the air gaps are right. We regularly find badly applied tape, unsealed joints and foil fitted wrongly, which undoes the airtightness and the thermal performance. We follow the manufacturer's installation instructions and take extra care over the sealing and finishing.

Recent Work

SuperFOIL Going In

A Recent Job

Victoria Avenue, Borrowash, 2026: the old loft insulation taken out, the loft floor vacuumed and cleaned, new insulation laid to specification, raised loft boarding for storage, and SuperFOIL fitted beneath the rafters.

When SuperFOIL Makes Sense

  • You want to cut heat loss through the roof or loft space
  • A loft room or dormer where there is little depth for insulation

How Long It Takes

Usually 1 to 3 working days, depending on the size of the property, the roof structure and access.
